 ICC CWC League 2 2026: UAE vs Netherlands Match 140 predictions, playing XI, team analysis and preview – October 25
 Netherlands Celebrate ©REUTERS 
 By Cricket World Staff 
 Saturday 24 October 2026 
 ICC CWC League 2 
 ODI series Schedule 140th ODI, Dubai Live United Arab Emirates 0/0 Netherlands UAE elected to bat
 United Arab Emirates elected to bat
 Live scores and commentary 
 Get the latest UAE vs Netherlands match predictions, cricket betting insights and match preview for Match 140 of the ICC CWC League 2 2026, scheduled for Sunday, October 25.
 Here are the Predictions for the ICC CWC League 2 2026, Match 140 - UAE vs Netherlands, to be played on the 25th of October at the ICC Academy, Dubai.
 Batting Stats ODI 
 Match 140 - UAE vs Netherlands (ICC Academy, Dubai) 
Ground Stat:
The ICC CWC League 2 action has now moved to Dubai where hosts UAE, Netherlands and Oman will participate in 6 ODI Matches.
Average First Innings Total at ICC Academy, Dubai (ODI's) - 244
Average Second Innings Total at ICC Academy, Dubai (ODI's) - 216
 Current Form UAE:  
 UAE are currently placed at the bottom most position on ICC CWC League 2 points table with 8 wins, 21 losses and 3 No Result Matches to their credit. 
The top run scorer for UAE in the ICC CWC League 2 is Rahul Chopra with 637 runs to his name. 
The top wicket taker for UAE in the ICC CWC League 2 is Junaid Siddique with 40 scalps under his belt. 
 When it comes to ODI's, UAE are in terrible form. They have lost all 3 out of their last 3 completed ICC CWC League 2 fixtures. 
UAE have named superstars like Muhammad Waseem, Junaid Siddique and Adeeb Usmani. They have better chances to win in their home conditions and especially with such a full strength squad. 
 Players to look out for:
1. Adeeb Usmani - He has been in good form lately. Usmani can pace his innings quite well in the 50 overs format. He will certainly play a big role for UAE in the ICC CWC League 2 games at home.
2. Junaid Siddique - He is an experienced fast bowler, who bowls with utmost accuracy and doesn't give a lot to the batters to work with. Siddique is expected to be amongst wickets in the upcoming matches.
 Current Form Netherlands:
 Netherlands are currently placed at the 3rd position on ICC CWC League 2 points table with 17 wins, 11 losses and 4 No Result Matches to their credit. 
The top run scorer for Netherlands in the ICC CWC League 2 is Max O'Dowd with 1004 runs to his name. 
The top wicket taker for Netherlands in the ICC CWC League 2 is Kyle Klein with 45 scalps under his belt. 
When it comes to ODI's, Netherlands are in good form. They have won 3 out of their last 4 completed ICC CWC League 2 fixtures. 
Netherlands are led by Bas de Leede for the League 2 games in UAE. Plenty of youngsters including Shariz Ahmad, Daniel Doram and Zach Lion-Cachet have been named in the squad. 
Netherlands are a spirited side and they are expected to go well in the upcoming matches. 
 Players to look out for:
1. Colin Ackermann - He is a capable top order batter and a useful off spin bowler. Colin Ackermann will be key to Netherlands' performance in UAE.
 2. Aryan Dutt - He has improved his bowling by a great degree over the last few years. Dutt may become the top wicket taker for Netherlands in the ICC CWC League 2 games in UAE.

 Netherlands Squad: Bas de Leede (C), Colin Ackermann, Shariz Ahmad, Noah Croes, Cedric de Lange, Daniel Doram, Aryan Dutt, Scott Edwards, Fred Klaassen, Kyle Klein, Michael Levitt, Zach Lion-Cachet, Max O'Dowd, Tim van der Gugten, Paul van Meekeren
